Glowing_Bioluminescent_Spore_Eyes.description: Embedded within the cephalon, these bioluminescent spore eyes emit an eerie glow, enhancing the host's perception and wisdom as they cast a soft, magical light that pierces through the darkest of shadows, granting both darkvision and the ability to emit light.

Stalk_Eyed_Mycelium_Sensors.description: Embedded within the fungal cephalon, the Stalk-Eyed Mycelium Sensors pulse with an otherworldly glow, enhancing the wearer's perception and granting them the uncanny ability to lock onto targets and remain perpetually alert, even in the darkest, most oppressive environments.

Hollow_Rotting_Wood_Sockets.description: Emerging from the withered, fungal-laden sockets of the Hollow Rotting Wood, these unnatural eyes pierce through the veil of the physical world, granting their host a profound wisdom and resilience against the horrors of decay while casting an otherworldly fear into the hearts of the living.

Toxic_Spores_Weeping_Eyes.description: The Weeping Eyes, a grotesque fungal cephalon, seethes with toxic spores that weep from its malformed ocular sockets, granting it an unnatural clarity of perception and a resilient constitution as it emits a poisonous cloud to shroud its foes in blinding, noxious despair.

Vibrant_Amanita_Patterned_Eyes.description: The Vibrant Amanita Patterned Eyes, with their iridescent hues and hypnotic patterns, are a mesmerizing blend of beauty and danger, enhancing the wearer's charisma and perception while granting the abilities to lure prey and lock onto targets with uncanny precision.

Cordyceps_Insectoid_Compound_Eyes.description: Emerging from the mutated cephalon of the insectoid host, these compound eyes pulsate with an unnatural green glow, their vision piercing through the veil of darkness to reveal hidden threats and opportunities, enhancing the host's perception and reflexes in the eternal dance of predator and prey.

Slime_Covered_Viscous_Eyes.description: These viscous, fungal eyes are covered in a layer of slippery slime, granting the cephalon remarkable agility and an enhanced perception that allows it to ignore the penalties of traversing through dense, treacherous terrain with ease.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Eye_Slits.description: The Hardened Shelf Fungus Eye Slits are a pair of stunted, fungal growths that serve as the primary sensory organs for a cephalon, their thick, chitinous walls providing a measure of protection against harm, though at the cost of slightly diminished perception.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Eyes.description: Embedded within the crystalline structure of the Underdark Fungus, these eyes pulse with an otherworldly glow, granting unparalleled wisdom and perception, as well as the ability to pierce the darkest recesses and reflect harmful spells back upon their caster.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Orbs.description: Emerging from the spectral essence of ancient, sentient fungi, the Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Orbs are eerie, floating orbs that resemble hollow, fungal eyes, granting their bearer a heightened sense of wisdom and the uncanny ability to move unseen, while also bestowing the ethereal sight to pierce through illusions and instill fear in those who dare to gaze upon them.
